accessNotes: Site is publicly readable, no geo-block or auth wall. THREE IMPORTANT CAVEATS: (1) The homepage pricing/spec area is a JS-driven tabbed widget. Two independent reads returned identical prices and identical spec rows; a third read conflated tabs and returned different loss limits for ACCELERATED (8%/5%/10% instead of 10%/4%/6%). Prices are treated as verified (2 identical reads + independent product-page confirmation for Break). Loss/target figures below are taken from /faq/ and /terms-and-conditions/, which state them in prose and agree with the two consistent homepage reads. (2) Product pages under /product/<size>-<name>-evaluation/ appear in search indexes but now return HTTP 404, so per-tier spec sheets could not be read. (3) The firm markets under names (Evaluation, Ascend, Accelerated, Instant, Break) but the FAQ/T&C state rules under structural names (2-Phase, 1-Phase, 3-Phase, Instant, Break). Mapping Accelerated -> '1-Phase' is supported by the homepage spec row (10% target / 4% daily / 6% max) matching the FAQ's 1-Phase figures exactly; it is corroboration, not proof. A '3-Phase' evaluation is described in the FAQ/T&C but is NOT sold on the homepage pricing widget, so it is omitted (no verifiable price). REFUNDABILITY: the site never states the evaluation fee is returned on a successful pass. The Refund Policy only grants a 14-day withdrawal right that is lost once a position is opened; T&C says 'In case of account(s) cancellation, you will not be entitled to the performance-based reward or the refund of the fees paid.' Because 'refunded on pass' is not stated either way, refundable is left null everywhere rather than guessed. PROFIT SPLIT: homepage spec rows say 80% at live stage for all products, and the Break page says 80%. T&C additionally lists a paid add-on: '90% Bonus Performance: Costs 20% of the evaluation price and increases your eligibility to receive up to 90%'. Conflictingly, T&C lists Ascend rewards as FIXED dollar scholarships ($210 on $5k, $420 on $10k, $1,050 on $25k, $2,100 on $50k, $4,200 on $100k, $8,400 on $200k) rather than a percentage split - flagged, not resolved. MIN TRADING DAYS: only Break and Instant are explicitly stated as zero; for the phase-based products no minimum is stated in prose, so null (not 0) is recorded. MAX TRADING DAYS: null because the FAQ states there is no time limit ('there is no maximum time limit to complete the evaluation'), i.e. unlimited rather than unknown.

rules.news: Allowed. FAQ: "Yes. News trading is allowed. We want traders to have the freedom to trade using their own strategy and style."
rules.weekend: Allowed. FAQ: "Yes. Traders are allowed to keep positions open overnight and over the weekend, regardless of the account type or instrument."
rules.overnight: Allowed. Same FAQ sentence as weekend.
rules.ea: Restricted. FAQ: "High-frequency trading is not allowed. This includes using programs, algorithms, bots, or automated systems to execute a large number of trades within very short periods of time." Tick scalping and arbitrage are also listed as not allowed. A blanket EA ban is NOT stated.
rules.copyTrading: Prohibited across accounts. FAQ: "Copy trading between different traders, third parties, groups, or unrelated accounts is prohibited."

fieldEvidence.profitTargets: VARIES BY TIER, so null at product level. T&C: Break $25k target is "5% of the initial demo capital"; Break $50k-$100k is "6% of the initial demo capital". The /break-challenge/ dollar figures ($1,250 / $3,000 / $6,000) match those percentages exactly.
fieldEvidence.dailyLossPct: null - the /break-challenge/ page states "No Daily Loss Limit". The trailing limit below is the only loss cap.
fieldEvidence.maxLossPct: VARIES BY TIER, so null at product level. FAQ: "For $25,000 and $50,000 Break accounts, traders must not register losses...exceed 4% of the highest demo account balance reached." and "For $100,000 Break accounts...exceed 3% of the highest demo account balance reached." Dollar amounts on /break-challenge/ ($1,000 / $2,000 / $3,000) confirm 4% / 4% / 3%.

fieldEvidence.consistencyRulePct: FAQ: "No single trading day may account for more than 40% of the total profits generated". /break-challenge/ Live Stage: "40%" - "no one day's profit is more than 40% of your total profits". Phase 1 has "NO" consistency rule; the 40% applies to the Live Stage only.
fieldEvidence.payoutFrequency: /break-challenge/: "Payouts on-demand: Yes". FAQ confirms Break payouts are "on demand".
fieldEvidence.maxTradingDays: FAQ: no maximum time limit. null = no limit.

globalRules.reverseTrading: Evaluation Rules page: "It is not allowed to create trades in opposite directions with a simultaneous duration equal or higher than 60 seconds". FAQ phrasing: "Reverse trading is not allowed when opposite positions are opened at the same time for 60 seconds or longer".
globalRules.maxProfitPerDay: Evaluation Rules page: "The daily and/or per trade simulated profit limit is $10,000". FAQ: "maximum simulated profit allowed per day and/or per trade is $10,000".
globalRules.prohibitedStrategies: Evaluation Rules page: high frequency trading, tick scalping, and arbitrage are banned. FAQ: "Tick scalping is not allowed", "Arbitrage strategies are not allowed".
globalRules.leverage: Homepage and /choose-your-challenge/: "Leverage Up To 1:100" on MetaTrader 5 and Match-Trader; Bybit "custom leverage up to 1:100".
globalRules.instruments: /choose-your-challenge/: MetaTrader 5 and Match-Trader "+540 Crypto Pairs"; Bybit "+715 Crypto Pairs".
globalRules.paidAddOns: T&C: "90% Bonus Performance: Costs 20% of the evaluation price and increases your eligibility to receive up to 90%". /last-updates-faq/: "Daily Drawdown 6%: Costs 15% of the evaluation value" and "Max Drawdown 12%: This costs 25% of the value of the assessment". A weekly payout add-on reduces the payout cycle to "every 7 traded days".

notCaptured: 3-Phase / Scholarship evaluation: rules are described in the FAQ and T&C (5% daily loss at 12:05 AM UTC, 5% max overall loss, 5% target in each of Phase 1/2/3, first payout after "5 traded days") but NO price or account-size table for it was found on the site, so it is omitted entirely rather than listed with null prices.

Per-tier product spec pages (/product/<size>-<name>-evaluation/) return HTTP 404 - could not obtain per-tier confirmation for Evaluation, Ascend, Accelerated, or Instant. Only Break has a working dedicated page.
Whether the evaluation fee is refunded on a successful pass - never stated on the site.
Minimum trading days for Evaluation, Ascend, and Accelerated evaluation phases - not stated in prose.
Consistency rule for Evaluation, Ascend, Accelerated, Instant - only Break's 40% rule is documented.

The homepage advertises "Up to $300,000" but the largest purchasable tier in the pricing widget is $200,000. The $300,000 figure could not be traced to a purchasable product, so no $300k tier is recorded.
